name: SEMrush Writing Assistant
summary: SEMrush Writing Assistant provides real-time optimization for SEO, readability, and originality. It offers actionable feedback to help writers create content that ranks and engages.
description:
SEMrush Writing Assistant provides real-time optimization for SEO, readability, and originality. It offers actionable feedback to help writers create content that ranks and engages.

SEO scoring with instant feedback. Readability, tone, and originality analysis. Integration with SEMrush ecosystem. Actionable suggestions for better rankings.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

howToUse.title: Sign Up or Log In
howToUse.description: Create a SEMrush account or log in to your existing account. Access the Writing Assistant from your SEMrush dashboard.

howToUse.title: Start a New Document
howToUse.description: Open Writing Assistant, start a new document, and paste or write your content.

howToUse.title: Set SEO Targets
howToUse.description: Enter your target keywords and select your region or language for tailored SEO recommendations.

howToUse.title: Optimize with Real-Time Feedback
howToUse.description: Follow actionable feedback on SEO, readability, tone of voice, and originality. Adjust your content to improve scores.

howToUse.title: Integrate with CMS
howToUse.description: Install the SEMrush Writing Assistant plugin for Google Docs or WordPress to optimize content directly in your workflow.
